## Purpose

Preserve the provenance and high-value BBMA lifecycle evidence found during CORE-V2-F7 Path A research without prematurely promoting a third-party web copy into canonical Strategy Core.

This file is a **source lead record**, not a replacement for an original workbook binary and not independent proof that every hosted page is byte-for-byte identical to the original commercial workbook.

One contemporaneous CariGold announcement states that the workbook breaks down the DVD explanations and includes transcription material so learners can retain the teaching points.

## High-value Strategy-Core / lifecycle evidence

### BBMA sequence

The workbook summary expresses the repeated lifecycle as:

`Extreme -> TP Wajib -> MHV -> CS Arah -> Re-Entry -> Momentum -> Re-Entry`.

This is consistent with the existing primary-PDF / Finale project cycle.

### Re-Entry followed by Momentum

The workbook states in substance that when Momentum occurs after Re-Entry, continuation remains active and the next Re-Entry is awaited.

### Re-Entry without Momentum

The workbook repeatedly states in substance that:

- direction -> Re-Entry -> no Momentum means close the position because reversal/rotation is expected;
- after MHV -> direction -> Re-Entry, if Momentum does not follow, TP is mandatory;
- summary teaching repeats that a Re-Entry without subsequent Momentum should be taken profit before the market rotates back.

This is a materially important **lifecycle exit lead** for F7.

### Timeframe-sensitive TP warning

A contemporaneous Home Course promotion reproduces an Oma Ally-attributed statement in substance that entering on M15 and then taking profit from a Daily target is wrong; the trader must be clear which timeframe is being traded.

Source:
`https://carigold.com/forum/threads/trading-plan-paling-hot-2015-dapatkan-set-lengkap-bbma-home-course-study.585138/`

This is corroborating evidence only until the original recording/source can be authenticated.

## What this source lead does NOT prove

It does not yet prove:

- an exact universal static H1 Re-Entry TP level;
- REM -> H4 outer BB TP;
- RRE/REE -> D1 outer BB TP;
- an exact number of candles before `NO MOMENTUM` is declared;
- a universal hard-SL formula for Re-Entry/REM/RRE/REE;
- exact broker-TP coexistence rules when lifecycle exit logic is active.

## Current project handling

- Do **not** promote this web copy to `PDF_CORE` or canonical Core solely from this record.
- Treat the post-Re-Entry Momentum/no-Momentum exit concept as a **strong source lead / product-linked historical evidence**.
- Keep deterministic implementation details `HOLD/UNRESOLVED` until stronger authentication and reconciliation exist.
- Do not change the frozen P3 EA candidate from this source lead alone.
